svg.title: Google News MCP Server, an open-source (MIT) Model Context Protocol server written and maintained by Chan Meng. It gives AI assistants such as Claude one tool, google_news_search, that searches live Google News and returns the results sorted into topics (AI & Technology, Business, Science & Research, Healthcare, General), with language and country codes and 10 languages listed. First commit 30 Dec 2024, 35 days after the Model Context Protocol was published on 25 Nov 2024; listed in 15+ MCP directories; 129 GitHub stars, measured 24 Sep 2026.
